package.name: openarmx_cyclo_box_align
package.description: Bimanual box-align (motion only): on an AlignToBoxes action goal, consume the latest detected boxes (/detected_boxes from box_perception_node), assign each to the nearer arm by base-frame Y, and move the assigned arm's link7 above its box at a commanded height and hand orientation (default vertical-down) through the cyclo MoveL controllers.
